items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1961-02-16
items.q: But I know they wouldn't fit men like George Bush.

ctx.x: George Gino was on there. That's why we had George Gino, because he met us a little before we left first, because of our Lord's suffering that stroke. But you see, if Joe Waskin wanted to come true then, you know, man, you get on the job saying, I know you can't leave a band like that, because that'd be wrong, because you can't pick up no Dixieland drummers and care not to fit them kind of, man. That's not an old-time band like that. And man, that'd be a real... Understand their style. You can run across good…
You ever work street parades on that? You ever worked some street parades on that?
